findings_qualitative.value: Filamentary gas streams from north and south converge on the central region; blue-shifted gas connects at the north-east edge and red-shifted gas at the south-west

evidence.quote: More precisely, the blue-shifted gas connects to the central area at its north-eastern edge, whereas the red-shifted gas connects at the south-western side.

findings_qualitative.value: Innermost kinematics are disordered with several velocity components, attributed to inflow plus protostellar feedback

evidence.quote: We speculate that this is caused by the interplay of the converging infalling gas with feedback processes from the forming central protostars.

claims.hypothesis: Does gas flow continuously from the parsec-scale cloud through filaments to the central cores of G351?
claims.experiment: Combined MALT90 single-dish, ALMA-IMF mosaic and DIHCA plus configuration 10 data and compared velocity structure across scales
claims.result: Intermediate-scale filaments connect spatially and kinematically to the larger-scale cloud and to the innermost cores
claims.finding: A hierarchical gas flow from cloud to cores is traced

evidence.quote: The intermediate-scale filaments connect spatially and kinematically to the larger-scale cloud as well as the innermost cores.

claims.hypothesis: How large is the filamentary mass inflow rate feeding the central region?
claims.experiment: Mass inflow rate from filament mass, velocity difference and length (with unknown inclination) using 1.3 mm continuum and DCN 1st moment
claims.result: North 0.77e-3 and south 0.86e-3 Msun/yr, around 1e-3 Msun/yr
claims.finding: Cluster-feeding rate of order 1e-3 Msun/yr onto a region hosting at least a dozen mm cores

evidence.quote: We estimate a filamentary mass inflow rate around $10^{-3}$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$, feeding into the central region that hosts at least a dozen mm cores.

claims.hypothesis: Is the inner kinematic structure ordered like the larger-scale flow?
claims.experiment: 1st moment, velocity-channel maps and pv diagram of H2CO(3_2,2-2_2,1) in the 0.027'' x 0.022'' combined data
claims.result: Blue and red gas at east and west edges agree with filaments, but no clear velocity gradients leading to individual cores
claims.finding: Within the central 1e4 au the kinematics are complicated and disordered, likely from inflow, outflow and cluster dynamics

evidence.quote: While the flow from the cloud via the filaments down to 10$^4$ au appears relatively ordered, within the central 10$^4$ au the kinematic structures become much more complicated and disordered.

claims.hypothesis: Is the inflow rate high enough to sustain the accreting protostars?
claims.experiment: Compared the inflow rate over the free-fall time (1.6e5 yr from ATLASGAL mass and size) with the mass needed for high-mass star formation
claims.finding: Accretion flow onto the central region is high enough to refill the reservoir

evidence.quote: we find that the accretion flow onto the central region is high enough to re-fill the reservoir feeding the central accreting protostars.

referee_caveats_inferred: Filament masses use a single dust temperature (30 K) and opacity with no uncertainty propagation
Flow rates assume gas streams along the filaments with no error bars on masses, lengths or velocity differences
Large-scale link relies on a 38'' single-dish map that was manually shifted by 22.9'' to match ATLASGAL
Only an infall interpretation of the 1st moment gradients is tested; rotation or outflow contamination of DCN and H2CO moments is not excluded

missing_for_reproduction: Full CASA imaging and masking parameters for the joint 3-configuration deconvolution

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Large: ALMA-IMF mosaic (7 m + 12 m, bands 3 and 6) plus DIHCA configs 5/8 and config 10 raw visibilities, likely hundreds of GB; MALT90 cubes are small
reproducibility.score_reason: Raw project codes are given but self-calibration, imaging and filament selection details are deferred to other papers or unstated; the main numeric results are a small table that depends on unspecified ellipse definitions.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Data availability is not stated in the paper and imaging, masking and filament-selection details are missing, so the Table 1 values cannot be redone from the text alone.
